strengths: 23 languages including German, 0.6B, zero-shot cloning, Apache-2.0

tona_fit.reason: Small, Apache-2.0, German supported, cloning, and a llama.cpp-style native runtime: a strong small TTS candidate next to Qwen3-TTS and Fish S2 Pro. Needs a German listening test and an A/B against those before an offer; the card's comparison mixes evaluation pipelines.
blockers: needs the vendor llama.cpp patch / Tona audio module
